findings.location: Homily PDF, physical page 1, left column: the movement break after 'and he calls them hypocrites.' (sections/homily/10-homily.tex, a \bigskip inside the shared properhomily environment of src/common/propers-homily.tex)
findings.problem: This defect is unchanged from run 4d16b5e19d25dad9. The shared environment sets flush-bottom columns, and the left column's only stretchable glue is this \bigskip. The break therefore opens to about 0.78 in: 157 px at 200 dpi, with 55 pt between the last baseline before it at y=412.9 pt and the next at y=479.4 pt. The speech's other movement breaks measure 52-77 px (page 1 right column 77 px; page 2 52, 74 and 67 px). On the first page it reads as a hole rather than one of the uniform breaks a speaker finds his place by. Nothing is lost or misordered.
findings.required_result: Every movement break in the speech is of the same height on every page, and the spoken text is unchanged. The general remedy is ragged-bottom columns in the shared properhomily environment. That is a maintainer-level change to src/common/propers-homily.tex, which no stage of this run may make, and no leaf-local dimension override should be used instead.

summary: Visual review of all three build PDFs of the Claude Twenty-ninth Sunday leaf, every page inspected: expansive study pc-s55-twenty-ninth-sunday-in-ordinary-time-year-a.pdf (sha256 99dfcd63a22fca05cdfe45681a32d4191440de4c36c1600eac6a3d354fe39304, pages 1-37 of 37), concise study -synthesis.pdf (a7548416bd93dea8149edc2bbc391ec647cfa8187319ea7008a36396671c7578, pages 1-12 of 12), homily -homily.pdf (6c71eddb0515a3015a5630b5862e69e265870acc886fff47df8d03208cefce55, pages 1-4 of 4). Every hash in research/artifacts.json (3 PDFs, 28 render inputs, 2 aux files) matches the current bytes, and each raster set's review-cache.json names the same PDF hash. I looked at the contact sheets, then opened all 53 full-size 200 dpi rasters. Mechanical checks: the three logs have no overfull or underfull boxes and no undefined references. All fonts are embedded Type 1 Latin Modern. The pages are US Letter, with no ink outside the 0.75 in text block on any page, and every raster has zero colour saturation (monochrome). Concise opening: the settled zref markers (inventory, overview and the four sense rows on abspage 1; chronology start and end on 2; themes 3-4; commentary start 5) match the pages. Page 1 has the complete 11-row map, with both Communion antiphons marked as options, and exactly the rows Literal, Allegorical, Moral and Anagogical. Page 2 has only Scriptural Date and Location, and the table ends just above the bottom margin. Pages 3-4 carry the Themes and Movement argument with no padding. Page 5 opens the commentary, organized by question, with the readings set side by side in each subsection. Lookup at reading size, concise page 2: the map's Second Reading, 1 Thes 1:1-5b, leads to the row 'Second Reading: 1 Thessalonians 1:1-5b'. Its occurrence ('Paul writes from Corinth (an ancient subscription says Athens)') and date ('Disputed: A.D. 52; A.D. 53-54') start on the same line (y = 710.6 pt in all three cells), so the pairing is immediate. A harder case also passes: the map's first Communion antiphon, Ps 33 (32):18-19, appears in three rows of the psalm group (Historical setting / Occasion date unresolved; Composition / Before c. 165 B.C.; Traditional attribution / Disputed: B.C. 1055-1015). Each row is labelled by its relation, top-aligned and set off by \addlinespace, and the group is closed by a rule. Expansive study: it is single-column throughout. The title and contents on page 1 are followed by the opening and map, the appointed texts, the element commentary and three keyed lanes (pp. 13, 17, 22), each with its own four-senses block, then the comparison table (p. 27). The Scriptural Date and Location table now runs from page 29 to page 30 with its header repeated. The break falls between book groups and splits no row, and I judge it acceptable for a terminal appendix. Standing items from run 4d16b5e19d25dad9: VIS-001 is substantively cleared, since page 28 now carries the last three paragraphs of the comparison (about 47% of the text block) and no orphaned paragraph. VIS-002 is repaired: rows within a group are separated (about 5 pt extra) in the study table as on concise page 2. VIS-003 is repaired: the page 7 text reads 'the word of life [to my glory...'. VIS-004 is still present and is restated below at its original advisory severity. Homily: full-width title; the 1,459-word speech in two columns on pages 1-2, with no loci or apparatus inside it; the full-width Note on Sources and Delivery and the References on pages 3-4. Final pages: a compact rights colophon ends each PDF on its last page (study p. 37, concise p. 12, homily p. 4), and none has a page of its own. Limits: no PDF/A or tagged-PDF claim. The installed pdf/ mirrors are still the earlier publication; their byte identity is for the install stage. The web edition is not in scope. No file, PDF or review of the GPT leaf for this identity was opened, and no search printed any of its content. Verdict: PASS, no blocking defect.
